figurative_meaning_en: High-caste Hindus such as Brahmins and Kayasthas
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজে বর্ণহিন্দুরা প্রায়শই বিশেষ সুবিধা পান।
তার পরিবার বর্ণহিন্দু, তাই তারা রক্ষণশীল।
example_sentences_in_english: In society, caste Hindus often receive special privileges.
His family is caste Hindu, so they are conservative.
history: Refers to the ancient Hindu varna system outlined in texts like the Manusmriti, dividing society into four castes with Brahmins at the top.
note: This term is more of a socio-religious descriptor than a traditional idiom, often used in discussions of caste dynamics in Bengal.
